def combination_sum2(candidates, target):
    candidates.sort()
    found = set()
    for mask in range(1 << len(candidates)):   # every subset: 2ⁿ
        pick = tuple(x for i, x in enumerate(candidates) if mask >> i & 1)
        if sum(pick) == target:
            found.add(pick)            # sorted input ⇒ equal multisets look equal
    return [list(t) for t in found]

def generate_parenthesis(n):
    res, path = [], []

    def dfs(opened, closed):
        if len(path) == 2 * n:
            res.append(''.join(path))
            return
        if opened < n:                 # can still open
            path.append('(')
            dfs(opened + 1, closed)
            path.pop()
        if closed < opened:            # can only close what is open
            path.append(')')
            dfs(opened, closed + 1)
            path.pop()

    dfs(0, 0)
    return res

def partition(s):
    res, path = [], []

    def dfs(start):
        if start == len(s):
            res.append(path[:])
            return
        for end in range(start + 1, len(s) + 1):
            piece = s[start:end]
            if piece == piece[::-1]:   # recurse only on palindromic prefixes
                path.append(piece)
                dfs(end)
                path.pop()

    dfs(0)
    return res

def subsets(nums):
    res, path = [], []

    def dfs(i):
        if i == len(nums):
            res.append(path[:])
            return
        path.append(nums[i])           # include nums[i]
        dfs(i + 1)
        path.pop()
        dfs(i + 1)                     # exclude nums[i]

    dfs(0)
    return res

def subsets(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    return [[nums[i] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1]   # bit i ⇔ take nums[i]
            for mask in range(1 << n)]

def subsets_with_dup(nums):
    nums.sort()
    seen = set()
    for mask in range(1 << len(nums)): # every subset, deduped by its values
        seen.add(tuple(x for i, x in enumerate(nums) if mask >> i & 1))
    return [list(t) for t in seen]
